## Context / Problem
`src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/` is package data imported by path: `_loader.py::lazy_load`, 44 in-package `try: from rebar_reconciler._loader import lazy_load / except ImportError` prologues plus hand-rolled loaders in twelve engine modules (`__main__`, `applier`, `differ`, `fetcher`, `inbound_collection_diffs`, `inbound_fields`, `inbound_translate`, `invariants`, `last_pass`, `pass_io`, `binding_repository`, `outbound_pass`; line cites in this ticket's first comment), `src/rebar/_lib_ops.py:161-173` `_engine_module`, `src/rebar/_cli/_bridge_commands.py:147-161` `_ref_lock_module`, `src/rebar/mcp_server.py:367-378` `_load_engine_mode` (the `rebar._engine_mode` fork), `src/rebar/_engine.py::engine_env` PYTHONPATH prepend (`:75-102`), and four `sys.path.insert` sites in `_cli/__init__.py` and `_commands/{_repair_pause,doctor_mapping,fsck_repair}.py` (cites in Approach step 5). The generic top-level name `rebar_reconciler` violates namespace hygiene (commit 24fc4901; `docs/architecture.md:244-272`), the by-path idiom forces a `sys.modules` key contract onto 343 test files (442 `spec_from_file_location` sites), and mypy widens every `rebar_reconciler.` annotation to `Any` (`pyproject.toml:627-634`). Operator decision (2026-09-06), BREAKING: the package becomes `rebar.reconciler` with no re-export shim (ADR 0083, ADR 0111); `python -m rebar_reconciler` becomes `python -m rebar.reconciler`; `engine_env` stops prepending `PYTHONPATH`. Cites are on origin/main 083620b0.

## Approach
1. `git mv src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler src/rebar/reconciler`. Rewrite every `from rebar_reconciler`, `import rebar_reconciler`, and `"rebar_reconciler.<x>"` string in `src`, `scripts`, `infra`, `tests` to `rebar.reconciler` (throwaway local codemod, not committed).
2. Delete `_loader.py`; delete every `try/except ImportError` loader prologue and every `lazy_load(...)`, `_load_*`, `_load_sibling_keyed`, `_try_load_step` call, replacing each with a plain `from rebar.reconciler import x` at module scope; function-local where a cycle exists, keeping the same names so `monkeypatch.setattr(module, name, ...)` targets survive. Delete the `__main__.py:363` reconcile-absent no-op branch.
3. Delete the `__main__.py:49-56` bootstrap fallback; `install_stderr_handler("rebar_reconciler")` (`:522`) becomes `"rebar"`; delete the `__init__.py` NullHandler (the `rebar` root already has one).
4. `src/rebar/_engine.py::engine_env` (`:75-102`): drop the PYTHONPATH prepend; it only pins `REBAR_ROOT`. `engine_dir()` stays for `jira-capability-probe.py` and `resources/`; its docstring and error text drop the reconciler.
5. `_lib_ops.py`: delete `_engine_module`; import `rebar.reconciler.{projects_store,pass_support,__main__,mode,last_pass,_ref_lock,access_check}` directly. `_bridge_commands.py:147-161,188-189` becomes `from rebar.reconciler import last_pass`. `mcp_server.py:359-378,599-600` deleted (`ctx` loses `MODE_CAPS` and `Mode`; no registrar reads them); `scripts/check_mcp_library_parity.py:130-131`, `scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py:97-98` drop the two kwargs. `_bridge_runner.py:146-151` becomes `from rebar.reconciler.__main__ import _Disposition`. `_cli/__init__.py:144-151`, `_commands/{_repair_pause.py:37-42,doctor_mapping.py:41-45,fsck_repair.py:342-347}`, `_engine_support/bridge_fsck_{drift.py:31-35,visibility.py:28-50}` become plain imports. `src/rebar/_engine/jira-capability-probe.py:25-26` imports `rebar.reconciler.*`.
6. Scripts hardcoding the directory are re-pointed to `src/rebar/reconciler`: `scripts/check_raw_git_writes.py`, `scripts/check_config_ownership.py`, `scripts/capture_jira_fixtures.py`, `scripts/generate_dc_wiki_legacy_outputs.py`, `scripts/jira_dc_capability_map.py`, `scripts/measure_baseline_normalization.py`, `scripts/measure_get_rotation_cutover.py`, `infra/scripts/comment_echo_reclaim_manifest.py` (line cites and the verified-untouched scripts in this ticket's first comment).
7. `pyproject.toml:567` per-file T201 ignore becomes `"src/rebar/reconciler/*"`; comments at `:14,68,509,613,627-634` updated. No hatch change (`packages=["src/rebar"]` already ships it; `artifacts` keeps `_engine/**` for probe and wordlist).
8. Tests (mechanical only): every `spec_from_file_location(<key>, <engine path>)` helper becomes `importlib.import_module("rebar.reconciler.<mod>")`; every `sys.modules[...]` seed of an engine module and every `_ENGINE_DIR` and `sys.path.insert` is deleted; `patch("rebar_reconciler.x.y")` strings become `"rebar.reconciler.x.y"`. Tests that needed a fresh module copy switch to `monkeypatch.setattr` on the shared module; `importlib.reload` of `rebar.reconciler.*` is forbidden. `tests/_engine_path.py` keeps only `repo_root()` (engine functions deleted by the next story). `tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py:27` assertion on `_engine/rebar_reconciler` removed.
9. Docs (line cites in this ticket's first comment): `docs/user-guide.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, `README.md`, `docs/exit-codes.md`, `docs/code-navigation.md`, `docs/coverage.md`, `docs/config.md`, `docs/reuse-surface.md` spell `python -m rebar.reconciler` and `rebar.reconciler`; `CHANGELOG.md` BREAKING entry; regenerate `docs/env-vars.md` with `python scripts/gen_env_registry.py`.
10. `.github/complexity-baseline.json`: re-spell the 6 engine keys to `src/rebar/reconciler/...`, ceilings unchanged (keys itemised in this ticket's first comment); operator-sanctioned maintenance edit (AGENTS.md forbids contributor hand-edits), recorded on the epic and restated in the commit message.

## Scope
`src/rebar/reconciler/**` (moved), `src/rebar/_engine.py`, `src/rebar/_engine/jira-capability-probe.py`, `src/rebar/_lib_ops.py`, `src/rebar/_bridge_runner.py`, `src/rebar/mcp_server.py`, `src/rebar/_cli/__init__.py` (lines 144-151 only; the CLI epic owns the rest), `src/rebar/_cli/_bridge_commands.py`, `src/rebar/_commands/{_repair_pause,doctor_mapping,fsck_repair,bridge_repair}.py`, `src/rebar/_engine_support/bridge_fsck_{drift,visibility}.py`, `src/rebar/_logging.py` (docstring), `src/rebar/_config_schema.py:665` (comment only), the scripts, docs, and tests listed above. Out of scope: `_config_sources.py`, `config.py`, `_deprecations.py` (config epic); the rest of `_cli/` (CLI epic); the test-side loader complex and the test-package rename (next story); every behavioural change to the engine.

## Testing
Happy: `python -c "import rebar.reconciler, rebar.reconciler.__main__"`; `python -m rebar.reconciler --help` exits 0 with no PYTHONPATH; `pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler tests/interfaces tests/scripts -q`; `make import-walk`; `make typecheck` (fix newly resolvable `rebar.reconciler._backend` annotation errors at site; add no `ignore_missing_imports`). Edge: `git grep -nE 'rebar_reconciler|lazy_load\(|_engine/rebar_reconciler' -- src scripts infra tests` returns only ADR, experiment, and frozen-fixture hits; `python -c "import rebar, rebar_reconciler"` fails (`tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py::test_library_path_exposes_no_generic_top_level_engine_names` still passes); `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_transport_param_typing_cc77.py` updated for the now-checkable port annotations; `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` prints `new=0 increased=0`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/` and `_loader.py` do not exist and `src/rebar/reconciler/__init__.py` exists, verified by `git ls-tree`.
- [ ] `git grep -nE 'spec_from_file_location|lazy_load\(' -- src` returns only the `src/rebar/graph/_loader.py` docstring.
- [ ] `python -m rebar.reconciler preview --repo-root <tmp>` runs from a fresh venv with no `PYTHONPATH`, verified by the `tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_cli_heldout.py` subprocess case.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0; `.github/complexity-baseline.json` has 6 `src/rebar/reconciler/` keys with unchanged ceilings (`check_complexity_baseline.py --check` prints `new=0 increased=0`).
- [ ] `python scripts/gen_env_registry.py --check` is clean.
